comparison.objective: Candidate performs state-dependent carton rejection on a conveyor; PR-1690 seats the final bicycle-tire bead, straightens the valve, and avoids tube damage.
comparison.physical_skill: Moving-object acquisition and level transport of loose contents versus bimanual bead slack generation, compliant pressing/rolling, and valve alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades correct open/closed routing, content retention, tray release, and 3 s stability; PR-1690 grades seated bead, straight valve, clear hands, and no leak or simulated pinch/strike violation.
comparison.reason: Both require damage avoidance, but the actual manipulation—carton interception and transport versus constrained bead seating—is meaningfully different.
